description: This file defines macros and inline functions for managing typed linked lists in C, including list initialization, addition, removal, and traversal, intended for use within the FY YAML parsing library.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_init
methods.description: Initializes a typed list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_add
methods.description: Adds a node to the list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_add_tail
methods.description: Adds a node to the end of the list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_push
methods.description: Pushes a node onto the list (alias for add).

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_push_tail
methods.description: Pushes a node onto the tail of the list (alias for add_tail).

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_empty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_is_singular
methods.description: Checks if the list has exactly one element.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_del
methods.description: Removes a node from the list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_insert_after
methods.description: Inserts a node after a specified node.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_insert_before
methods.description: Inserts a node before a specified node.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_head
methods.description: Returns the first node in the list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_tail
methods.description: Returns the last node in the list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_first
methods.description: Alias for list head.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_last
methods.description: Alias for list tail.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the first node.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_pop_tail
methods.description: Removes and returns the last node.

methods.name: fy_<type>_next
methods.description: Returns the next node in the list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_prev
methods.description: Returns the previous node in the list.

methods.name: fy_<type>_lists_splice
methods.description: Splices one list into another.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_splice_after
methods.description: Splices a list after a specific node.

methods.name: fy_<type>_list_splice_before
methods.description: Splices a list before a specific node.
